hero.title: Better data for better site choices
hero.description: SiteSynergy brings land, solar, grid, and infrastructure data into one assessment workflow to make site comparisons clearer.

progress.title: How we make site assessment simpler

content.problem1: Data for site selection often sits in separate maps, reports, and files.
content.solution1: We bring those sources into one workflow to simplify early site review.
content.problem2: Raw data alone is not enough to compare options.
content.solution2: We organize and filter relevant information to make each site’s opportunities and constraints clearer.
content.problem3: Reviewing multiple locations should be repeatable and traceable.
content.solution3: We designed geospatial data workflows to reduce manual steps.
content.breakthrough: This step provides more structured inputs for initial site screening.

content.problem1: Once data is gathered, teams need to understand what affects each option.
content.solution1: We developed scoring and filtering models to show promising options and their constraints.

subPhase.title: Connect technical and location factors
subPhase.problem2: A single score without its underlying factors is not enough for a decision.
subPhase.solution2: We show solar yield, grid access, land use, and permitting constraints together.
subPhase.problem3: Result quality depends on input data and expert review.
subPhase.solution3: We present results so assumptions and limitations can be examined.
subPhase.breakthrough: Our goal is to help teams compare options transparently before detailed studies.
